profile.name: Helmut Chaparro Sandoval
profile.title: Electronic Engineer
profile.summary: Electronic engineer in Bogotá, with an emphasis on embedded systems, hardware, software, data and artificial intelligence, robotics and bioengineering. More than six years building end-to-end solutions. Founder of DevKit Electronics S.A.S and owner and founder of Poimen Labs S.A.S.
profile.about: I am an electronic engineer. For more than six years I have designed, built and led complete solutions, where the circuit, the firmware, the software and the data are designed as one system.

scenarios.text: I write firmware for STM32 and ESP32, integrate sensors and carry device telemetry all the way to the server.
I design multilayer boards in Altium Designer and KiCAD, from the schematic to assembly and validation.
I build services and APIs in .NET and C#, with SQL Server for data and TypeScript for the interface.
I model data, build extraction and transformation pipelines and turn them into dashboards that support decisions.
I train models with TensorFlow and PyTorch and take them to the edge; I work on computer vision, retrieval-augmented generation and agents.
I design and program robots and mechatronic prototypes, with ROS 2, simulation and control.
I process physiological signals: photoplethysmography with a phone camera, filtering and heart-rate metrics.
I found and lead multidisciplinary teams: requirements, architecture, roadmap and delivery.

tags: Founder and General Manager · DevKit Electronics S.A.S
Owner and founder · Poimen Labs S.A.S

experience.summary: Engineering and STEM education company that I founded and lead. We turn the needs of institutions and the market into products, services and repeatable implementation programs.
experience.contribution: I built the company from scratch, along with the technical capability behind it. I designed the architecture that joins hardware, firmware, software and data into one product, and built a portfolio of courses, robotics kits and laboratory systems that schools and universities already use.
bullets: I lead the company in strategy, operations, product direction and technical delivery.

I am responsible for end-to-end solution architecture: multilayer PCB, embedded firmware, sensors and data acquisition, IoT connectivity, backend services, web platforms, educational software, robotics and laboratory equipment.
I integrate device and application data into workflows for ingestion, transformation, monitoring, dashboards, reporting and automation, using Python, SQL and APIs.
I lead multidisciplinary teams in electronics, software and pedagogy: I define requirements, roadmaps, documentation, validation criteria and delivery priorities.
I bring artificial intelligence into prototypes and product workflows when it adds value: machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation and agents.

experience.summary: AgriTech company that I founded and of which I am the owner. It applies electronics, automation, sensing, data and software to agricultural monitoring and field decision support, under the real conditions of Colombian agriculture.
experience.contribution: I took the idea of technology for agriculture to a complete, deployable architecture, from the sensor in the crop to the producer's dashboard. I defined how things are measured, how data travels with limited connectivity, and how it becomes alerts and decisions, using low-cost hardware and energy-efficient firmware.
bullets: I founded Poimen Labs and I am its owner; I direct the company's strategy and engineering.
I design integrated architectures: sensor nodes, edge acquisition, telemetry, rural connectivity, control logic, backend services and dashboards.
I turn field measurements into structured information, alerts and traceable operational indicators for producers.
I apply data engineering to IoT flows: ingestion, transformation, structured storage, time series, data quality and visualization, with Python and SQL.
I manage the full product cycle: requirements and architecture, integration of PCB, enclosure, firmware and software, validation pilots, feedback and iteration.

experience.summary: Enterprise software for international trade, customs and logistics operations.
experience.contribution: I contributed across the full stack of software that handles real foreign-trade operations. I turned operational requirements from customs and logistics into services, data models and integration processes that can be maintained, watching over scalability, security and performance for high-volume clients.
bullets: I developed enterprise solutions in .NET and C# for customer management, customs operations, imports, DIAN compliance, logistics and business integrations.
I built and maintained backend services, REST APIs, business logic and data structures in SQL Server: queries, relational models and data validation.
I implemented extraction, transformation and loading processes with SQL Server Integration Services, plus integration flows and reports.
I worked across all layers, including JavaScript web components, in an agile, remote team, with version control and technical documentation.

experience.summary: Teaching robotics and embedded AI to help close the STEAM education gap.
experience.contribution: I designed and taught specialized learning experiences in robotics, automation, electronics and embedded systems with AI, integrated into curricular projects. I guided each student through a complete technical project: from the circuit and the sensors to programming, autonomous behavior, testing and a working prototype.
bullets: Led STEAM initiatives to reduce the education gap in public institutions.
Designed robotics, automation and embedded AI courses, integrated into the curriculum projects.
Guided students from their first circuit to a working autonomous prototype.

experience.role: Software Developer and Educational Robotics Consultant
experience.summary: Educational robotics taken from circuit to classroom, ready for the market.
experience.contribution: I was the bridge between engineering and the client: I developed software, programmed robots, designed circuits and supported on-site implementation. I turned technical capabilities into educational robotics products that institutions could adopt, and I provided support, adjustment and follow-up during their rollout.
bullets: Managed educational robotics projects for sale to district and educational institutions.
Programmed educational robots, developed electronic circuits and provided on-site consulting.
Bridged engineering and sales, turning technical capabilities into products that institutions could adopt.

experience.org: Computers for Education · Ministry of Education
experience.summary: Mechatronic prototypes and STEAM programs that reached vulnerable communities across the country.
experience.contribution: I led complete design-to-implementation cycles for mechatronic and educational prototypes for schools and vulnerable communities, balancing what engineering allows with what the territory can use and sustain. I left installed capability behind: I trained teachers and communities to run and maintain the technology on their own.
bullets: Led the full design and development cycle of mechatronic prototypes using a STEAM methodology.
Applied PCB design, 3D modeling, robotics and programming (Python, C/C++) for education and vulnerable populations.
Trained teachers and communities so they could sustain the technology on their own.

experience.summary: Leading student communities in robotics, biomedical and humanitarian technology.
experience.contribution: I lead student technical communities in robotics, computational intelligence, biomedical engineering and humanitarian technology. I coordinate teams, events, workshops and partnerships, and connect the academic world with the professional and community world.
bullets: Held chair positions in the IEEE Student Branch, RAS, EMBS and the Humanitarian Technologies chapter.
Currently chairing the RAS, SIGHT and CIS student chapters.
I organize technical events, workshops and activities that connect students with real-world engineering.

competencias.name: NAVIRA-SATViRe
competencias.summary: Early warning system for landslides and slope failures. First place at the national hackathon.
competencias.detail: Built during the national hackathon organized by the National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) and UNDP. It combines low-power sensor nodes with edge inference and an alert chain to give communities early warning of mass-movement events.

competencias.name: GDG Cartagena Hackathon
competencias.summary: Third place at the Google Developer Group (GDG) Cartagena hackathon, in the technology and risk management challenge.
competencias.detail: Territorial risk management system for Cartagena: it identifies affected zones and estimates budget exposure and the impact on mobility, economic activity, tourism and other sectors of the city. Its indicators and dashboards make the effects by zone and by sector visible, to prioritize mitigation and the allocation of resources.
